title: Planar Degenerate Anchoring in Landau-de Gennes Energy
summary: The aim of this article is twofold. First, in the large-body limit and when the temperature is below the nematic-isotropic transition threshold, we verify that the $\mathbb{S}^2$-valued energy-minimizing harmonic map on a bounded smooth domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^3$ with tangential boundary condition is a singular limit of the Landau-de Gennes energy minimizers subject to the Fournier-Galatola planar degenerate anchoring [22].
